entities.name: Velena
entities.description: Member of Shanna's crew on the Weatherlight, assigned to the weapons podium, killed by Phyrexian powerbolts.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Airship whose crew included Velena; it was compleated.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: Leader whose crew Velena belonged to.

entities.name: Arvad
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member who searched for Shanna.

entities.name: Elmegraun
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member killed with Velena by powerbolts.

events.summary: Velena identifies the bone dragon and urges the crew to act.
events.quote: she quickly identified the dragon and urged the crew to take action

events.summary: Velena, Arvad and Elmegraun go to find Shanna and warn her group of the danger to the Weatherlight.
events.quote: They found Shanna's group along the trail

events.summary: Sickly green powerbolts hit Velena and Elmegraun, melting them into puddles and killing them instantly.
events.quote: Velena and Elmegraun were directly hit by the powerbolts, which melted them into puddles, killing them instantly.

relations.note: She was crew on the ship.
relations.quote: Velena was a member of the Weatherlight 's crew
Velena was one of Shanna 's crew on the Weatherlight
